name: Membership Plan

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Only active plans can be sold. Switching a plan off leaves its members as they are.

fields.label: Billing Period
fields.description: Monthly: from the start day to the day before the same day next month. Yearly: to the day before the same day next year.

fields.label: Price per Period
fields.description: Saved as the plan item's selling price.

fields.label: Billed Item
fields.description: The service item on the invoice: non-stock, one per plan. Left empty, saving the plan makes one. Saving the plan turns on deferred revenue for it and points it at the Deferred Membership Revenue and Membership Revenue accounts. Whether it is taxed follows the item's own Item Tax Template.

fields.label: Registration Item
fields.description: Charged on a customer's first invoice of this plan only, over the same service dates as that first period. Left empty with a fee set, saving the plan makes one.

fields.label: Auto-renew by Default
fields.description: Pre-ticks Auto-renew when the plan is sold. Auto-renew saves the customer's card for recurring charges.

fields.label: Membership Terms
fields.description: Optional. A Per document agreement the customer signs for each membership before it is invoiced.

fields.label: Grace Period on Failed Renewal
fields.description: Off: the first failed renewal charge suspends the membership. On: the charge is retried daily for the grace days, then the membership is suspended.

description: A membership a customer can buy: what it costs, how often it bills, and its registration fee.
